parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resources.

This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified in the request.

Valid values:

- true: Detaches all tags from the specified resources. If a resource has no tags, the operation is skipped and a success message is returned.

- false (default): Does not perform any tag operation and returns a success message.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource is located. Call [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~) to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The only valid value is `instance`.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag keys. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.
